note: ground: lab draws the ground of this folder (cells as real domes from a baked life), standing draws the ground of convect.ts. sim: the life of the cells, a power diagram of sites on a tile that repeats (tile and radius in stage units, times in seconds). dome: the shape of a cell (arc: the angle of its profile from crown to foot in degrees, more than 90 hangs over the foot; height: of the cell's mean radius; flat: how flat the top is, 1 a round arc). lod: a dome is drawn with the finest mesh above the first size in pixels of a 1080 frame, the middle above the second. spot: the warp that combs the cells toward the spot (pull, wide in stage units), the funnel of its pit and the umbra (of the approved umbra's half width). fibre.counts: threads a radian of the fan from the root, three sizes. heat: the temperature of the matter (floor: the coldest, body: the dome's own, cool and hot: a cool and a hot thread, knot: a knot of rising matter, edge: what is left on a steep flank, pen: in the penumbra, bloom: how much brighter than white a heat over 1 is). haze: the thin glowing haze low over the ground (amount, scale: the height it thins by, level and tint: its light, power: how fast it thickens as the look flattens). dome.over: the footprint of a dome over its cell, more than 1 cuts into its neighbours; lobe: how deep the creases between the lobes of a top are; pen: the height left in the penumbra. fibre.root: how far the dark of the root reaches along the fibres. heat.core: how far from the crown the hot patch reaches, rim: the heat of the cooler matter round it, thread: how strong the threads are in the patch and round it, glint: the small points on a rim.
